devices.title: Pick radiators to control
devices.description: Borrowing your existing Tuya cloud session - no sign-in needed. Tick the radiators you want to control from Home Assistant.

error.no_selection: Pick at least one radiator to import.

abort.already_configured: Tuya Radiators is already set up for this host integration.
abort.no_host_integration: Couldn't find a loaded Tuya integration to borrow from. Install either the official Tuya integration or Xtend Tuya first, sign in there, then try again.
abort.no_radiators_found: No radiator-class devices were found on your Tuya account.

write_failures.title: {name}: writes to {field} keep failing
write_failures.description: The last {count} cloud writes to {field} on {name} have all failed. The radiator may have lost WiFi, or the Tuya cloud may be unreachable. State changes you make in HA are reverting because the cloud isn't accepting them. Press the radiator's Refresh from Cloud button (or call the tuya_radiators.refresh service) once connectivity is back; this notice clears automatically on the next successful write.

reconcile_failures.title: {name}: cloud reconcile keeps failing
reconcile_failures.description: The last {count} attempts to fetch state from the Tuya cloud for {name} have all failed ({error}). Entities will go unavailable after 90 s of staleness. Check whether the host integration (tuya or xtend_tuya) is still authenticated, and that your internet is reachable. This notice clears automatically on the next successful reconcile.
